subject: value of dynamically generated textInput widget oscillates depending on typing speed

messages.author: 1f481370609de517
messages.subject: value of dynamically generated textInput widget oscillates depending on typing speed
parts:
Hi.

I have an application with 0 or more textInputs, depending on user's actions.  I create them dynamically, and trap their values inside the server context.  When I re-generate the UI, I re-populate the textInput values from my trapped copies, since their their number may have changed for other reasons.  

Ideally the user should be able to alter the text in the UI, and application should respect each alteration.  But apparently when typing at just the right rate, it is possible to drive the system into an unstable state where the text displayed alternates between the current and former input.  In some cases, the system stabilizes on one value.  The problem is more evident when more inputs are present.

Minimal example follows, with one hard-coded input.  Is it possible to trap or avoid this condition?

Thanks,

Tim


library(shiny)
shinyApp(
  server = function(input, output) {
    value <- ""
    output$ui <- renderUI({
      value <<- input$txt_0
      textInput("txt_0", "text", value)
    })
  },
  ui = fluidPage( fluidRow( column( 10, uiOutput("ui"))))
)
